title: Photoresistor Component Visualization
description: This is a simple p5.js visualization showing the characteristic structure of a photoresistor (Light Dependent Resistor).
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the serpentine cadmium sulfide pattern of a photoresistor and explain how it maximizes light-exposed surface area
Explain why incident photons excite electrons in the semiconductor and lower the component's resistance
Compare a photoresistor's dark resistance (about 1MΩ) with its bright-light resistance (about 50-100Ω)
Describe how pairing a photoresistor with a fixed resistor in a voltage divider converts light level into a readable voltage
